caption: The drawing depicts a square piece of lacework featuring a symmetrical design rendered in white against a black background. The lace is composed of small, evenly spaced grid-like holes formed by intersecting threads. The central area of the lace displays a large, eight-pointed star or floral motif, with each petal extending outward from the center. Surrounding the star are additional geometric shapes, such as diamonds and crosses, also worked in the same white thread. Around the central motif, there are several rectangular and square sections filled with different mesh patterns, including solid and openwork areas. The outer edge of the lace is bordered with a scalloped fringe created from loops of white thread, which forms a decorative frame to the entire piece. The composition is set within a thick black border that contrasts with the lighter lacework, and this, in turn, is surrounded by a plain, light-colored background.
title: Lace Hardanger
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
